profile.headline: Software Engineer at Medallia
profile.summary:
Hi, I currently hold two degrees in Digital Media, and Information Technology from the University of Central Florida.  Having both these skill sets I'm able to develop and design web based applications.  

My past experiences have given me the opportunity to work with a variety of technologies from responsive CSS frameworks to JavaScript libraries.  However, I enjoy seeking out and learning new trends in the industry, whether it be a design principle or front-end framework.

Skills: JavaScript, AngularJS, jQuery, Dojo, ext.js, AJAX, JSON, PHP, ZF, Responsive Design, CSS, Columnal, Twitter Bootstrap, SVN, git, HTML, Motion Graphics, Video.

Thanks for stopping by!

positions.title: Solutions Engineer
positions.description:
•	Revamped existing .NET web application with responsive CSS framework.
•	Led front end design and development for web based resume building application.  Technologies included JavaScript, jQuery, AngularJS, and twitter Bootstrap.
•	Resolved tickets and implemented new features for enterprise level financial forecasting software

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
At EDR I had the opportunity to work on developing front and backend solutions for enterprise level K-12 Student Information Systems.  The technologies that I gained valuable experience in were:  JavaScript, jQuery, Dojo, AJAX, JSON, PHP, Zend Framework, Responsive Design, Columnal and Twitter Bootstrap Frameworks.

In addition to the tools that were available to me, I was also involved with creating custom Dojo dijits and jQuery widgets, to fulfill development requirements.

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description:
•	Acted as lead on redesign project of  Lockheed Martin’s Prepar3D website. 
•	Successfully presented mockups based off high traffic areas from Google Analytics.
•	Created all assets in Photoshop and implemented into custom Wordpress theme.

http://www.prepar3d.com

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description: Setup energy information systems software which tracked consumption of utilities.

positions.title: Graphic Designer, Video Editor
positions.description: I've had the opportunity to freelance with local Orlando professionals in many different fields.  The work ranged from logo design to video production.
